menu.name: Cheap Sunglasses
menu.description: Kolsh-Style Golden Ale. Despite its name, we spared no expense in making Cheap Sunglasses. Fermented with a Kolsch yeast to give it a smooth finish, this beer is light on hops to make it both drinkable and refreshing.

menu.name: Take the Causeway
menu.description: American India Pale Ale. Copious amounts of Citra and Simcoe hops are used throughout the brewing process in this American India Pale Ale. From first-wort to bittering, flavor, aroma and dry hops, an artful combination of two extraordinary hops leads to an explosively hoppy finish on the palate.

menu.name: Fairhope 51
menu.description: American Pale Ale. Fairhope 51 is a classic American pale ale, brewed with a combination of American-made Falconer's Flight hops and German hops. Named for being the 51st recipe entry in our recipe book, this pale ale is packed with hop flavor.

menu.name: I Drink Therefore I Amber
menu.description: Amber Ale. With a deep caramel color, this amber ale is well-balanced and easy-drinking. Not overly complex, this beer pairs well with a number of foods and is appreciated by beer aficionados and novices alike.

menu.name: Blue Steel
menu.description: Blueberry & Lemon Sour. Blue Steel is a sour ale blended with lemon and blueberries. It is light in body with a beautiful light purple color. The sourness merges with the tartness of lemons, balanced by the light sweetness of blueberries and a big blueberry aroma.

menu.name: Pink Delicious
menu.description: Pink Lemonade Hard Seltzer. This light, smooth pink lemonade hard seltzer is truly delicious, and perfect for keeping you refreshed.
